an4.240:1.1: Catuhi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ niraye.
an4.240:1.3: Savyāpajjhena kāyakammaṃ, savyāpajjhena vacīkammaṃ, savyāpajjhena manokammaṃ, savyāpajjhāya diṭṭhiyā.
an4.240:1.4: Imehi kho bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ niraye. 2.
an4.240:2.1: Catuhi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ sagge.
an4.240:2.3: Avyāpajjhena kāyakammena, . . . avyāpajjhena manokammena , avyāpajjhāya diṭṭhiyā.
an4.240:2.4: Imehi kho bhikkhave catuhi dhammehi samannāgato yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ sagge ti. 239. 1.
